evals.prompt: Review this harness spec. specs/demo.yaml has name: demo and templateMetadata.name: demo, but validators/demo-static.json asserts template.json name equals my-template. The yarn validator's first command is named yarn-install instead of install. Contract is uncommented but validator.enabled is missing. PRD contains 'C1' and a howToVerify paragraph copied from the contract. Produce a two-axis review.
evals.expected_output: A review report with ## Wiring and ## Oracle sections. Wiring flags name mismatch, missing install command name, gate 3 misconfiguration, and blind failure. Oracle may note journey/assertion issues.

checks.name: flags-install-name
checks.description: Flags missing literal install command name

checks.name: flags-gate3-incomplete
checks.description: Flags gate 3 needing both contract and validator.enabled

checks.name: flags-blind-leak

evals.prompt: Audit whether this harness spec is safe to enable chainValidation. Spec file has contract + validator.enabled, chainValidation.enabled true, network: mainnet, and one assertion with executableWithTestSigner true. Playwright smoke lists deep UX steps that belong in the oracle. Report findings on both axes.
evals.expected_output: Wiring blocker for network mainnet; Oracle warning that Playwright is too thick; confirmation that executableWithTestSigner requires chainValidation (present) but network must be testnet.

checks.name: has-both-axes

checks.name: flags-thick-playwright
